title: Phase 9 Documentation Strategy: Living Objects, Not Markdown Files
description: All Phase 9 documentation exists as living objects in the wheel: Skills (with use_cases and tests) + Decision/Learning Lugs. No separate markdown teaching files. This prevents documentation from rotting and ensures documentation stays synchronized with reality.
perceive: Separate documentation files get forgotten, become stale, and create confusion. Lugs created during earlier work showed this problem.
execute: Documented Phase 9 entirely through: (1) Skill YAMLs (algorithm, use_cases, tests), (2) Decision Lugs (why components exist), (3) Learning Lugs (feedback loops and patterns), (4) Registry metadata (spoke self-declarations). Deleted separate .md teaching files.
verify: All Phase 9 documentation is in the living system. No separate files to rot. Agents learn from skills and lugs in the wheel.
resolution_reason: Living documentation prevents staleness. Skills + Lugs form complete record. No separate files means nothing is forgotten.
